Now write the following. Return only the requested text.
Write a monthly engineering update for a team of twelve, covering a migration, two hires, and a slipped deadline. Around 200 words.

September Engineering Update

We finished the database migration this month. The team moved the primary datastore from Postgres 12 to 15 over a scheduled weekend window, with read replicas cut over first and the write path following once replication lag held at zero for six hours. One rollback drill ran mid-week as a rehearsal; it worked, and we didn't need it for the real cutover.

Priya Nair joined the platform team and Jamal Reyes joined infrastructure. Both are ramping through the onboarding project and pairing with existing team members this week.

The search reindexing project missed its August 29 deadline. The delay traces to a schema change in the upstream events service that broke our indexer's field mapping partway through testing. We're rewriting the mapping layer now and expect to ship by September 12.

On-call load stayed low, the CI pipeline runtime dropped by four minutes after we parallelized the test suite, and the billing service handled last week's traffic spike without incident.

We'll finish search reindexing next month, start the on-call rotation redesign, and get Priya and Jamal past onboarding into their first solo tickets.
